info.title: Demo Payment Gateway Simulator
info.description: Local synthetic API. Signed interactive user identity or broker-issued user token with current exact-operation grant required. JWT subject owns the account; caller user headers do not grant authority. A separate read-only settlement machine lane retrieves captured charge proofs. Legacy fixture mode is outside this reference security profile.

get.description: List personal and household accounts belonging to the trusted actor.
List owned synthetic funding methods. Wallet/card management does not move money.

post.description: Save an owned synthetic card preset; never submit card numbers or security codes.
Version-checked card disable/reactivate/tombstone; no automatic funding fallback.
Select an active default for future drafts, without changing existing approvals.
Verify provider ownership then link a synthetic biller account.
Archive an owned biller link while retaining its historical reference.

get.description: Read this account’s AED demo wallet.
List the latest 100 account-owned payment transactions.

post.description: Top up a wallet using a simulated approved or declined funding source.
Capture or decline a simulated payment. Amounts use integer AED fils. Never submit card details.

get.description: Look up an account-owned captured or declined charge.

post.description: Refund a captured charge at most once.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Keycloak access token

Error.description: Validation, ownership, delegation, payment, conflict or availability error

x-idempotency-policy: Persisted per account for the lifetime of the demo database. Reusing a key with a different method, path or body returns 409.
